summary: We had the privilege of visiting the National Association for the Blind (NAB), Worli, where we donated: 100 T-shirts, 100 White Canes & 10 Fans.
description:
We had the privilege of visiting the National Association for the Blind (NAB), Worli, where we donated: 100 T-shirts, 100 White Canes & 10 Fans. It was truly a heartwarming and memorable experience!

The programme began with a special demonstration of massage therapy and general reflexology by trained NAB students. We also had the opportunity to visit their recording studio and printing factory, which is one of the largest in India, producing magazines and educational books in Braille for visually impaired students across the country.

To make the day even more special, a delicious meal was arranged for all the NAB students, generously sponsored by PP Rtn. Sunita & Vikas Hirlekar.

Special thanks to Rtn. Suman Kapoor and Non-Medical Director Rtn. Rakesh Kansara for their wonderful efforts in organizing the visit, logistics and activities.
